best_human.source: Reconstructed 10-by-10 patch of the triangular lattice generated by 1 and omega_1; see Engel et al. arXiv:2406.15317v3, §2.1 and Definition 2.4.
best_human.provenance: Traditional human lattice construction. The formula is reconstructed for n=100; the source's 439 entry is kept separate.
best_human.evidence_state: All 100 points are saved. Exact pair check gives 261 unit distances.

best_public.provenance: Traditional GPU beam search on the Moser lattice; no generative-AI contribution is reported in the source.
best_public.evidence_state: Publicly reported, not reproduced; 22 found isomorphism classes. The linked dataset could not be retrieved.

best_reproduced.origin_type: traditional triangular lattice construction reconstructed and checked

optimality_status.evidence: The checked sources report u(100)>=439 but provide no matching upper-bound proof. Exact values through n=21 do not settle n=100.
optimality_status.limitations: 439 remains unreproduced here and is a reported lower bound, not a proved maximum.
